suggestion: Function description is shorter than 80 characters: add trigger conditions, validation logic, processing steps, outputs, and error handling.
Function description exceeds 2000 characters: split the function or trim the description to the process information needed for CFP estimation.
Invalid funcId format: use uppercase alphanumeric segments joined by hyphens, at least two segments, 1-8 characters each, e.g. USR-FAV-01.
Level-1 function name must not use generic words like manage/process/system/handle/control: name it as a concrete business object plus action, e.g. 'Add Favorite'.
Level-2 function name must not use generic words like manage/process/system/handle/control: name it as a concrete business object plus action, e.g. 'Remove Favorite'.
Level-3 function name must not use generic words like manage/process/system/handle/control: name it as a concrete business object plus action.
